svg.text: From SEM crops to ordered / disordered predictions
Classical supervised learning with engineered image features
Filename labels supply y; grayscale pixels supply X.
One feature row per image + known label y
Keep every crop from the same sample-area group in one split. Metadata defines groups, not predictors.
Fit feature scaling where needed, then a classifier.
Logistic Regression, Tree, Forest, Naive Bayes,
KNN, or SVC learns from feature rows + labels.
Tune Tree / Forest / KNN / SVC using grouped
cross-validation within the training split only.
Pass test features through the fitted model.
Compare predictions with known test labels:
What the model learns: a decision rule connecting measured image patterns to the two labels.
Shown crops are dataset examples, not model predictions. HOG and component variants are separate experiments.
